summary: Iter 91h — Verified the new canonical units-sold semantic-layer endpoint and its frontend wiring on Overview & ExecutiveSummary. All 7 pytest tests pass and the data-integrity audit script reports 0 defects (canonical = STS units_sold = 66,651 for last-90d, 19,810 for Kenya MTD, 46,607 for current quarter, 0 for empty combo).

tests_executed.audit_script: audit_91l_data_integrity.py → OUTPUT 1 = 0 defects across all 4 metric groups (Stock on Hand, Revenue, Units Sold, Orders)
tests_executed.frontend_smoke: Overview + ExecutiveSummary loaded after admin login; canonical endpoint wired correctly

backend_findings.endpoint_shape: GET /api/analytics/canonical-units-sold returns 200 with {units_sold:int, definition:'vivo_merchandise', filter:{...}} — shape verified across 5 filter states
backend_findings.reconciliation: canonical-units-sold == STS units_sold rollup for every audit state — single source of truth holds
backend_findings.regression: GET /api/kpis still returns 200 with total_units/units field intact (legacy field untouched)

overview.kpi_units_value: Shows 218 for 1 Jun 2026 (today). API /api/analytics/canonical-units-sold?date_from=2026-06-01&date_to=2026-06-01 returns 218. Raw /api/kpis.total_units = 222. KPI tile uses the canonical (218) NOT the raw (222) ✓
overview.prev_period_value: vs Last Month baseline = 816 = canonical for 2026-05-01 (raw was 831) ✓
overview.formula_tooltip_text: Source code confirms KPICard formula = 'How many individual Vivo merchandise items left the shelves (excludes Accessories, Sale, Other & Third-Party Brands — canonical definition C).' ✓ Contains both required phrases (Vivo merchandise + canonical definition C).
overview.network_listener_note: Direct network listener captured 0 calls because Overview had already loaded canonical data before listener attached (login redirect → /overview was synchronous). Validated via value comparison instead — kpi-units numerically matches the canonical API for both current and prev windows.

executive_summary.kpi_units: YTD 106,418 (LY 101,176, +5.2%) — matches main agent's reported values ✓
executive_summary.network_calls_observed: 4 canonical-units-sold calls fired on ExecSummary mount (YTD-cur, YTD-LY, MTD-cur, MTD-LY) all returning 200 ✓
executive_summary.mtd_window_observation: MTD calls use date_from=2026-06-01, date_to=2026-05-31 (inverted range because reporting day = yesterday May 31 but month-start = today June 1). Backend returns 0 gracefully. This is a pre-existing windowing quirk on day-1-of-month, not introduced by iter 91m.

frontend_findings.console: No JS errors caused by iter 91m changes. Pre-existing benign warnings only (Recharts width/height warnings on hidden tabs; 2 unrelated 401s from prior session).

issues: MTD windows produce inverted date range (date_from > date_to) on day-1-of-month when reporting = yesterday. Currently returns 0 — works but could be tightened to skip the network call or fall back to (today, today). Pre-existing, not introduced by 91m.

action_items: (Optional) Guard MTD windows in ExecutiveSummary against day-1-of-month where date_from > date_to to avoid wasted canonical API call — currently harmless (returns 0).
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint correctly registered, response shape validated.
Tooltip text contains both required phrases ('Vivo merchandise' and 'canonical definition C').
Falls back gracefully to raw kpis.total_units while canonical is loading (good UX during cold cache).
ExecutiveSummary.jsx is ~2500 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into sub-components in a future iter (pre-existing issue, not new in 91m).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Overview canonical override verified by value comparison; ExecSummary canonical network calls verified by listener)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 91m canonical Units Sold endpoint is healthy and reconciles with STS. The audit script at /app/backend/tests/audit_91l_data_integrity.py is the go-to regression for cross-page metric drift; rerun after any future units/revenue/stock changes. Note that Overview triggers canonical fetch on initial mount, so capture listener BEFORE goto if you need to inspect the request in playwright.
